name: bug
description: Something is not working (issue forms add this)

name: feature-request
description: Suggestion or accessibility need from the feature form

name: S1
description: Severity 1: crash, save loss or progression block (docs/qa/bug-process.md)

name: S2
description: Severity 2: major feature broken, no workaround

name: S3
description: Severity 3: workaround exists, or clearly visible defect

name: found-in
description: Build the bug was found in (put the build id in the issue form)

name: fixed-in
description: Build the fix shipped in (put the build id in the closing comment)

name: repro:often
description: Reproduces more than half the time

name: repro:rare
description: Reproduces less than half the time

name: behaviour-change
description: PR intentionally changes characterisation snapshots or golden replays

name: known-issue
description: Listed in docs/qa/known-issues.md for the public build

name: sla-breach
description: Not acknowledged within the triage SLA (S1 24 h, S2 72 h)

name: triaged
description: Severity, area and owner agreed at triage

name: verified
description: Fix verified by QA in the fixed-in build

name: needs-replay
description: S1/S2 gameplay bug without an F8 replay or a reason why not
